title: Hawk-Eye ko kaise pata ball stumps pe lagti?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Ball pad pe ruki... par Hawk-Eye bolta hai: stumps pe lagti!
Sab jodo... ball ka 3D raasta ready!
Pad ke baad? Raasta AAGE badha diya!
[laughs] Ye reel DRS gawaane wale dost ko bhejo!
caption:
Ball pad pe ruk gayi... phir bhi DRS bata deta hai ki wo stumps pe lagti ya nahi. Kaise? 🏏

Hawk-Eye ke 6 high-speed camera har second 340 frame lete hain. Computer sab camera ki photos jod ke ball ka 3D raasta banata hai, aur pad pe lagne ke baad usi raaste ko aage badha ke dekhta hai ki ball stumps tak jaati ya nahi. Company ke hisaab se average galti sirf 3.6 mm! 🤯

Agla "kaise" kis cheez ka chahiye? Comment karo 👇
